lateReviewFixes.issue: A first pending Goal with failing preclaim native read could starve other eligible Goals.
lateReviewFixes.resolution: Read-only rowid-based rotating pending cursor; at most 20 candidates per service scan, one native preflight/round, and at most 200 in-memory 30-second read backoffs. Global initialization occurs only with nonempty eligible work and fails globally, not once per Goal.
lateReviewFixes.verification: CoreDomain 102-Goal regression and LocalCoreService A-fails/B-progresses, exact 30-second delay, full-backoff-page traversal, empty queue and global-initialization cases.
lateReviewFixes.safetyBoundary: No claim/reservation/trigger consumption for failed native preflight. Restart may repeat only a zero-inference read; durable unknown evaluations are never replayed.

lateReviewFixes.issue: Runtime startup awaited the first Core evaluation, allowing a slow native read to prevent dashboard availability.
lateReviewFixes.resolution: Start the owned pump without waiting for its first evaluation; retain its work for shutdown cancellation/drain.
lateReviewFixes.verification: Final Runtime targeted report and full package check.

lateReviewFixes.issue: Stopping one Goal fenced Task effects but did not immediately abort its delegated worker stream.
lateReviewFixes.resolution: After committing local pause/cancel and aborting active Core work, invoke trusted synchronous onGoalStopped before waiting for native lifecycle locks; Runtime cancels controllers belonging to that Goal.
lateReviewFixes.verification: Service pause/cancel ordering and argument-isolation tests, resume-no-notification assertion, and final Runtime stop regressions.

bounds.tokenMeterKind: fixed-density heuristic; may anchor on prior usage but future surface deltas remain heuristic
bounds.accounting: reservation, actual observed usage reconciliation and overage freeze; cannot undo already incurred usage
bounds.modelCallsScope: native middleware dispatches visible to this adapter

drainLimitations.limitation: If native create/whenIdle or a durable callback does not settle, retain ownership and wait for drain; no detached background create or automatic replay.

packaging.exitCodeBasis: parent execution completion report; JSON manifest independently parsed and current file sizes verified
packaging.note: This is a dry-run packaging manifest, not installation, deployment, upload or a real-host load test. README and other Markdown files are excluded from the source hash freeze.

coverageBoundaries: Core accepts explicit local-owner Goals and enumerated local-note deliverables; model proposals cannot enlarge owner scope, content, authority or budget.
Core context uses owner Goal/request and same-Goal Task/Effect metadata. Retractable memory bodies are not loaded into Core Goal Sessions in this slice.

Durable trigger, reservation, native dispatch/result evidence, candidate validation and Task admission remain distinct. Unknown rounds are retained for explicit or independent reconciliation, never automatically dispatched again.
A known invalid proposal is rejected only after exact native evidence and complete settled accounting. A later completion failure preserves an already committed decision and is surfaced separately.
Completion requires independent local artifact readback and fresh completion proofs at both native authorization points; synthetic fixtures do not establish real-host completion acceptance.
Native decisionRound uses an ordinary bounded followup and does not increment DSH Goal continuation-round counts; nativeGoalRound remains false.
Reserved total tokens plus the output cap do not establish a hard total billing ceiling. Token metering is heuristic; observed usage reconciliation and overage freeze cannot undo incurred usage.
Provider-internal retries and complete Session/provider billing are unknown. The known primary stream count is not a whole-host cost audit.
Shutdown retains ownership and waits for native and callback work to drain. A never-settling native operation is not proven to terminate within a hard deadline.
Automatic long-history recovery/compaction, complete cross-channel operation, Core memory context and general autonomous planning acceptance remain outside this offline slice.
UI full 168/168 precedes the final defaults/copy edit; the final edit has a separate 3/3 targeted run. No final-source all-168 rerun is claimed.
